Container.Name: Buzz-Transcription
Container.Requires: NVIDIA Driver plugin, a compatible NVIDIA GPU, and an amd64 Unraid server. Single-user desktop; use on a trusted local network or VPN.
Container.Overview: Transcribe audio and video with Buzz in your browser. Choose your Input folder and Output folder, then click Apply. Everything else is prefilled. After installation, click the Buzz icon and choose WebUI. In Buzz, click + and open your recordings from /input; transcripts and subtitles are saved to /output. Requires the Unraid NVIDIA Driver plugin with a working NVIDIA GPU. Settings, downloaded models, and browser uploads are saved automatically. For use on your local network or VPN.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: The browser port is prefilled. Change it only if another app uses it.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Stores settings, history, and downloaded models in a dedicated folder. Existing installations should keep their current mapping.

Config.Name: Input folder
Config.Description: Choose the folder containing your audio or video files. In Buzz, click + and open /input. Originals stay unchanged.

Config.Name: Browser uploads
Config.Description: Stores files sent with the Upload files button. The default is ready to use.

Config.Name: Output folder
Config.Description: Choose where Buzz saves transcripts and subtitles. Buzz saves them here automatically.

Config.Name: NVIDIA GPU
Config.Description: Uses all NVIDIA GPUs by default. Change this only to select a specific GPU.

Config.Name: NVIDIA capabilities
Config.Description: GPU computation and diagnostics; desktop rendering uses software.

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: Unraid nobody user; match the owner of your writable folders.

Config.Name: File permission mask
Config.Description: New files are writable by the users group.

Config.Name: Reduce GPU memory
Config.Description: Enable INT8 inference; the container adapts it to Pascal GPUs.
